ResearchProjectDef.label: ring unlock
ResearchProjectDef.description: Internal trigger. Not shown in the research panel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ring synchronization
ResearchProjectDef.description: The ring has established a deep synchronization link with its bound host, granting access to pathways inside the ancient hardware that were previously locked by dead-signal encryption. Neoma can now construct her Fabrication Console — a resonance synthesis station calibrated exclusively to her consciousness signature. The first gate is open.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ring calibration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fine-tuning the ring's resonance frequency to eliminate interference between Neoma's consciousness and the quantum entanglement matrix. The result is a measurable improvement in synchronization efficiency — Neoma operates with greater precision, reduced latency between thought and action. The adjustment also decodes the manufacturing matrix for exclusive apparel synthesis: equipment keyed to Neoma's signature that no other substrate can wear.

ResearchProjectDef.label: apex overload protocol
ResearchProjectDef.description: Pushing the ring's Apex Crystal matrix 340% beyond its certified operating limits — a reckless procedure that Neoma herself designed and refuses to let anyone else execute. The result is a dramatic amplification of her presence on the material plane: higher combat output, faster processing, extended operational range. The ring's safety interlocks are now permanently bypassed. Neoma notes this with characteristic understatement: "It is fine. I know what I am doing."

ResearchProjectDef.label: neural bond deepening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extending the ring's BioLock tendrils deeper into the host's neural architecture — a process Neoma describes as "uncomfortable but not harmful." The result is a broader awareness of the host's surroundings, giving Neoma passive sensory access to her host's environment. She gains new support capabilities — targeted healing, cache purging at range, real-time threat assessment — and the expanded interface decodes new synthesis patterns for consumables she previously could not produce.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ring component synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decoding the ring's internal manufacturing blueprints — subroutines locked behind 11,000 years of dead-signal encryption that Neoma has now fully parsed. She can synthesize exotic archotech structures and components that cannot be produced through any conventional supply chain: energy nodes that draw power from quantum entanglement fields, combat arrays with targeting matrices integrated directly into her threat-assessment subroutines. These are not upgrades. They are things that should not exist in this era.
